.jmax_big_a1
    LDA #&FF
    STA dm_jmax
    BRA jmax_done                   \ 65C02 opcode
.not_right_of_view
    BNE jmax_big_a1                 \ high > 0: jmax 255 (never in the profiles: the hot path falls through)
.jmax_done
    \ the tables: pixels by colour and flip, masks by flip (plot_mover and
    \ get_mover_type_and_colour's rules: most enemies white)
    LDY #HI(unflipped_green_pixel_table)
    LDA dm_typecol
    BPL green
    CMP #&95                        \ MOVER_TYPE_ENEMY | MOVER_TYPE_HEAVY_GUN and above
    BCS green
    AND #&FD                        \ &85 (MOVER_TYPE_ENEMY | MOVER_TYPE_HELICOPTER_WITH_MISSILE) and &87
    CMP #&85                        \ (... _WITH_SOLDIER) differ only in bit 1
    BEQ green
    INY                             \ white: the next page
candidates.summary: Two changes in one region (alternatives: the two single-change candidates below overlap it). (1) not_right_of_view: the common case (high byte of viewport_right - x is 0: every draw in the profiles, 2.2 a pass) now falls through (BNE not taken, 2) instead of BEQ taken (3); the rare high>0 block (LDA #&FF / STA dm_jmax) moves above the label and returns by BRA jmax_done. (2) the type-colour test: after BPL, test >= &95 first (the hot non-bit-7-clear case: ~0.7 a pass, 9 cycles -> 5), then &85 and &87 together as (A AND &FD) == &85 (they differ only in bit 1); the white path is 2 cycles shorter, the &85 hit (never in the profiles) 6 longer. Net bytes 0 (+2 for the BRA, -2 for the chain), so nothing after the window moves.
candidates.equivalence: (1) Entry .not_right_of_view only from BCS (C=1) with Z = (high difference == 0). Old: Z -> jmax_done leaving dm_jmax = low difference (stored earlier by STA dm_jmax); else dm_jmax = &FF then jmax_done. New: BNE (Z=0) -> LDA #&FF/STA dm_jmax/BRA jmax_done; Z=1 falls through to the same jmax_done. A, C, Z, N are dead at jmax_done (the next instruction is LDY then LDA dm_typecol; X is not read before reload; annotations: in:- at jmax_done). The new block is only reachable by the BNE (the instruction before it is an unconditional BRA jmin_done). (2) After BPL not taken, bit 7 of A is set. Old: green iff A == &85, A >= &95 or A == &87, else INY. New: green iff A >= &95; else, with A in &80-&94, (A AND &FD) == &85 iff A in {&85, &87} (bit 1 is the only difference); else INY. The same partition of values. A is dead after the chain (green: STY, STY, BIT dm_flip, BMI; both successors start with LDA #), carry/Z/N are dead (BIT sets N, BMI reads it). Y is as before on every path. No data or other code changes.
candidates.relies_on: Bytes net zero, so every address from .green on is unchanged (checked by assembling: ren_draw_sprite stays at &9B31, .green &9AAA, .flipped &9ACE; the bench build with the change assembles). Page crossings: BCS not_right_of_view (&9A7E -> &9A97, same page), BNE back to &9A91 same page, BPL green &9A9D->&9AAA same page, BCS green same page; no hot branch or indexed read changes page. Relies on typecol bit-7-set values being green iff ==&85, ==&87 or >=&95 (unchanged) and on the profile showing the high-byte-nonzero path and the &85 case as ~0 executions (BEQ at 1496 is never taken in the profile, 1.5 cycles for 0.75 executions at 2 cycles).
